h: Peace Draws Blessing While Dispute Reveals Its Opposite

p: In the holy Zohar on this parsha
כַּד בָּרָא קוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא עָלְמָא
"When Hakadosh Baruch Hu created the world,
of the upper and the lower beings."
For behold, the bestowal of all blessings
and it is stated (Midrash Rabbah, Kedoshim):
and "Tziyon" has the numerical value of "Yosef."
is the Name of Hakadosh Baruch Hu,
that He was, is and will be:
Aleph at the beginning of the letters,
(as is written in Midrash Rabbah, Vayishlach,
And Midrash Rabbah on this parsha
and in the new Midrash Tanchuma
and the Yalkut the reading is,
שֶׁשָּׁלוֹם שְׁמוֹ שֶׁל הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא
that Shalom is the Name of Hakadosh Baruch Hu,
which indicates the entire Name Havayah,
and he is "one opposite the other"
So opposite this in the kelipah,
which is the whole structure of the body,
Yesod is the end of the body;
For Samael includes in the kelipah
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (זֹהַר חֵלֶק ב קמח, ב)
is the root of the curse.
And this is what it says:
in the giving of the Torah,
which is the source of blessing.
that it was smiting for Mitzrayim
(כְּעֵין מַה שֶּׁכָּתוּב זֹהַר חֵלֶק ב לו, א)
(similar to what is written, Zohar II 36a);
they went out with each plague
the serpent, Chavah, Adam and the earth.
And the letter Tav in holiness,
all the hyperbolic numbers in Shas
for this is the greatest number
is already of the World to Come.
And opposite this, in the reverse,
וַתָּקִיא הָאָרֶץ אֶת יֹשְׁבֶיהָ (שָׁם יח, כה)
"and the land vomited out its inhabitants" (Vayikra 18:25).
And this is what it says:
And this is what they expounded:
from the attribute of Keser Elyon
and machlokes is the opposite of this.
